description: Potentieel gasopslag (historie) is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by kaartportaal.drenthe.nl. Suitability of gas fields for gas storage in the provinces of Groningen, Friesland and Drenthe. File part of potential gas storage map in empty gas fields. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Potential gas storage (history)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2008-12-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
